capabilities: Comment on selected text with threads that can be replied to, edited, resolved, or reopened
Highlight and color text with customizable palettes, opacity, and shapes
Ask ChatGPT, Claude, or OpenCode for replies from a comment thread
Keep comments stored in the vault without changing note content
Follow text edits and note renames so highlights stay attached
disambiguation: Not a PDF or web annotation tool; it comments on and highlights text inside your own notes.
extras: Only runs on macOS with Apple silicon. Local comments and highlighting work offline without any account; AI replies send the current note and thread context to the selected provider, with privacy and permission controls documented separately. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach comments to specific passages of a note without editing the note text itself.
